description:
Create unit and integration tests for PySpark SQL adapter,
mirroring the structure of existing PySpark DataFrame tests.

Test coverage requirements:
- Session management (singleton, configuration, shutdown)
- Schema creation (DDL translation, constraint handling)
- Data loading (CSV, Parquet, TBL formats)
- Query execution (timing, result collection)
- Integration with TPC-H SF=0.01

All tests must include Java version skip logic since
PySpark 4.x is incompatible with Java 23+.
